previous_description: The Research Seminar is a space to present work in progress, share early-stage ideas for feedback, invite an external speaker, or propose a research workshop. It normally meets on the last Friday of the month from 10:00 to 11:00 a.m. in a hybrid format at CDUP and on Zoom.

current_public_information.seminar_description: The UP Research Seminar welcomes presentations of work in progress, early-stage research ideas, talks by external researchers, and research workshops.
current_public_information.seminar_description_es: El Seminario de Investigación de la UP recibe propuestas para presentar investigaciones en desarrollo, compartir ideas de investigación en etapas tempranas, invitar a investigadores externos y organizar talleres de investigación.
current_public_information.seminar_schedule: The seminar normally takes place on the last Friday of each month, from 10:00 to 11:00 a.m., in a hybrid format with in-person participation and Zoom.
current_public_information.seminar_schedule_es: El seminario normalmente se lleva a cabo el último viernes de cada mes, de 10:00 a 11:00, en formato híbrido, con participación presencial y por Zoom.
current_public_information.seminar_schedule_note: Specific dates, speakers, and participation details will be confirmed for each session.
current_public_information.seminar_schedule_note_es: Las fechas específicas, los ponentes y los detalles de participación se confirmarán para cada sesión.
current_public_information.seminar_form_note: The proposal form is in Spanish and takes approximately five minutes to complete.
current_public_information.seminar_form_note_es: El formulario de propuestas está en español y toma aproximadamente cinco minutos.

seminar_proposals.label: Work in progress
seminar_proposals.description: Present a research study or project in progress during a 30–60 minute session.
seminar_proposals.description_es: Presenta una investigación o un proyecto en desarrollo durante una sesión de 30–60 minutos.

seminar_proposals.label: Early-stage research ideas
seminar_proposals.label_es: Ideas de investigación en etapas tempranas
seminar_proposals.description: Share an early-stage research idea and receive feedback from colleagues.
seminar_proposals.description_es: Comparte una idea de investigación en una etapa temprana y recibe retroalimentación de colegas.

seminar_proposals.label: External researchers
seminar_proposals.description: Propose a talk by an external researcher.
seminar_proposals.description_es: Propón una charla de un investigador externo.

seminar_proposals.label: Research workshops
seminar_proposals.description: Request a workshop on topics such as LaTeX, GitHub, good research practices, or creating an academic website.
seminar_proposals.description_es: Solicita un taller, por ejemplo, sobre LaTeX, GitHub, buenas prácticas de investigación o cómo crear una página web académica.
